definitions.explanation: Something or someone different from what has been mentioned; alternatives.

examples.japanese: {他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いくつか→いくつか：28363_ikutsuka⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several others besides this store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In addition to work, time for hobbies is also important.

examples.japanese: {他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: There's no other way, so I have no choice but to do it.

notes:
KANJI VARIATIONS:
- {他|ほか} - other (abstract, general)
- {外|ほか} - outside, other (physical sense)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in addition, besides)
- {他|ほか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (other ~, another ~)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{他|ほか} (and others, etc.)
- {他|ほか}⟦ならぬ→なる：01970_naru⟧ (none other than)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{他|ほか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (besides ~, in addition to ~)
- 〜{他|ほか}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (have no choice but to ~)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ - another, different
- ⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧ - other than, except
